note: TestRFC8522MandatoryCommands proves both polarities: positive pingCases executes IPv4, IPv6 (protocol=2,1), and DNS hostname (example.com) asserting StatusOK, jsendSuccess, exact min/avg/max, rate 100, and non-empty rfc8522OutputText; negative badPing rejects protocol mismatch and invalid host with StatusBadRequest and jsendError.
